CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 03 / 10

Scarcity, choices and opportunity cost

Valuing alternatives比較方案價值

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Compare alternatives using benefits and opportunity costs, including benefits that are not naturally expressed in dollars: ask what someone would be willing to pay for them.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

可用願付價格衡量快樂或休息等非金錢收益。把每個方案的收益減去相關成本，並包括放棄收入，再比較淨收益。

Put benefits and costs on a common scale using willingness to pay. Compare the net benefit of each feasible option, including time and forgone income. A benefit can have economic value without being cash income.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A trip brings enjoyment valued at $500, costs $200 and replaces $150 work. Net advantage over work = 500−200−150 = $150. 旅遊的額外淨收益為 $150。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Enjoyment is worth $300; ticket costs $100; forgone wages are $250. Net advantage of attending? 參加活動的淨優勢？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
